summary: A rocket or any engine-driven craft that lifts off, flies and lands.
status: written; flame, smoke trail, shake and kick tested in the space-adventure story

required_in_behavior_file.solid: true: it stands on the ground as a solid thing

rules_the_engine_applies_automatically: thrust block on an object: orange flame under it that flickers and fades in/out
smoke puffs stay where the rocket was when each puff was born, so a rising rocket leaves a trail
shake move before liftoff, camera kicks at ignition
flame length is half the rocket height unless the scene says more
the camera can frame the rocket automatically while it flies
hatch: a door in the side opens and closes at the times the scene gives (orange rim, dark opening); a climber disappears into it
landing legs: four struts unfold at deploy time and reach the ground
not_done_yet: real fluid smoke (Blender particles) - the trail is card puffs
hatch is added by code to any rocket model; it is not cut out of the generated model
how_numbers_are_chosen: hand-written default ratios today; real rockets would take sizes from a source.
